e.title: **「矩不存在时，它返回 NA，而不是一个没有总体对应物的数字」**：R 包 **hgr**（The hidden grammar of reserving，v0.5.0）——**出发点是「经典准备金方法其实是可信度估计量」这一句**；**把**负二项链梯（NB-CL）**、**统一可信度准备金（UCR）**、**Mack 无分布模型**与**复合负二项–Gamma（CNBG）**收进一个框架**；**⭐ 它逐字写出自己**在哪些地方不该被信任****（**「**for anything that matters**」**请用 bootstrap 或后验，**别用闭式方差**）**；**⭐ 并逐字点名两个诊断**回答的不是同一个问题**
e.title_en: When a moment does not exist it returns a missing value rather than a number with no population counterpart: the R package hgr, titled the hidden grammar of reserving at version 0.5.0, starts from the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators and unifies negative binomial chain ladder, unified credibility reserving, a distribution-free model and a compound negative binomial gamma amount model, while stating verbatim which of its own outputs should not be trusted for anything that matters and naming two diagnostics that answer different questions so that a portfolio can pass one while failing the other.
e.title_hk: **「矩不存在時，它回傳 NA，而不是一個沒有總體對應物的數字」**：R 套件 **hgr**（The hidden grammar of reserving，v0.5.0）——**出發點是「經典準備金方法其實是可信度估計量」這一句**；**把**負二項鏈梯（NB-CL）**、**統一可信度準備金（UCR）**、**Mack 無分布模型**與**複合負二項–Gamma（CNBG）**收進一個框架**；**⭐ 它逐字寫出自己**在哪些地方不該被信任****；**⭐ 並逐字點名兩個診斷**回答的不是同一個問題**
e.summary: **hgr**（**The hidden grammar of reserving**，**包版本 0.5.0**；GitHub `robin-vo/hgr`）**是一个通用保险准备金方法的 R 包**，**它的一句话出发点逐字为**「**based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators**」**——**⭐ 即**链梯、**Bornhuetter-Ferguson、**Cape Cod **在他这套里是**同一个可信度框架的特例**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-01-29、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**语言 R**；**许可** GPL (>= 3)**（`DESCRIPTION` 字段；**而**仓库内**未见 `LICENSE` 文件**）**；**依赖极轻**（`Imports` 只有 `MASS`、`stats`、`graphics`**）**，**而** `Suggests` 里含** `ChainLadder`、`MCMCpack`、`rstan (>= 2.26.0)`、`testthat (>= 3.0.0)`、`ggplot2`**；**本条目属于本轮主题**「反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上」**，**它是本轮靠**「**谁在 README 里提到我们已收录的工具**」**这一搜索找到的**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得抄**：**① **矩不存在就返回 NA****——**逐字**「**The package enforces this and returns `NA` for the mean and standard error where they do not exist, rather than a number with no population counterpart.**」**；**② **逐字指名「**别用哪个函数**」****——**逐字**「**use the bootstrap or the posterior, not `delta_method_var()`, for anything that matters**」**；**③ **两个诊断不是一个门槛****——**逐字**「**They answer different questions and a portfolio can pass one while failing the other.**」**。**⚠️ 本次未安装 R、**未运行任何模型、**未复现其任何覆盖率数字**。
e.summary_hk: **hgr**（**The hidden grammar of reserving**，**套件版本 0.5.0**；GitHub `robin-vo/hgr`）**是一個通用保險準備金方法的 R 套件**，**出發點逐字為**「**based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators**」。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-01-29、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**R**；**許可** GPL (>= 3)**（`DESCRIPTION` 欄位；**倉庫內未見 `LICENSE`**）**；**依賴極輕**（`Imports` 只有 `MASS`、`stats`、`graphics`**）**，**而** `Suggests` 含 `ChainLadder`、`MCMCpack`、`rstan (>= 2.26.0)`、`testthat`、`ggplot2`**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得抄**：**① **矩不存在就回傳 NA****（**逐字**「**rather than a number with no population counterpart**」**）**；**② **逐字指名「**別用哪個函式**」**（**「**use the bootstrap or the posterior, not `delta_method_var()`, for anything that matters**」**）**；**③ **兩個診斷不是一個門檻**（**「**a portfolio can pass one while failing the other**」**）**。**⚠️ 本次未安裝 R、未運行任何模型**。
e.summary_en: The R package hgr, titled the hidden grammar of reserving and released at version 0.5.0, **collects general insurance reserving methods into one framework**, and its one-line starting point states verbatim that it is based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators, **which means chain ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson and Cape Cod appear here as special cases of a single credibility framework**. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-01-29**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **one star**, language R; **licence GPL version 3 or later by the description field**, though **no licence file is present in the repository**; and dependencies are unusually light, with only MASS, stats and graphics as imports, while the suggested packages include the chain ladder R package, a Markov chain package, Stan, testthat and ggplot2. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry**, and it was found by asking which repositories mention a tool this wiki already holds. **Three passages are worth copying**: where a moment does not exist the package returns a missing value rather than a number with no population counterpart; it names verbatim the function not to trust, telling readers to use the bootstrap or the posterior rather than the closed-form variance for anything that matters; and it ships two diagnostics rather than one threshold, saying explicitly that they answer different questions and a portfolio can pass one while failing the other. **R was not installed, no model was run, and none of its coverage figures was reproduced this round.**
e.body:
**hgr**（**逐字全名**「**The hidden grammar of reserving**」）**是一个通用保险准备金方法的 R 包**，**本次实测版本为** `0.5.0`**。**本次实测**：**GitHub 仓库** `robin-vo/hgr`**，**创建 2026-01-29、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**语言 R**；**许可**为 `GPL (>= 3)`（**`DESCRIPTION` 字段**；**⭐ 而本次文件清单里**未见 `LICENSE` 文件****）；**作者** `Robin Van Oirbeek`（**⭐ 其 `Authors@R` 里的** ORCID **字段为空字符串**——**本词条如实记录**）**；**依赖**：`Imports` **逐字只有** `MASS`、`stats`、`graphics`，`Suggests` **逐字含** `ChainLadder`、`MCMCpack`、`rstan (>= 2.26.0)`、`testthat (>= 3.0.0)`、`ggplot2`；**另有** `Encoding: UTF-8`、`Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)`、`RoxygenNote: 7.2.3`、**以及** `Config/testthat/edition: 3`。**仓库文件清单实测 65 条**：`DESCRIPTION`、`NAMESPACE`、**四个 R 源文件**（`cnbg.R`、`multinomPI.R`、`nbcl.R`、`ucr.R`**）**、`README.md`（**8,165 字节**）、**四个示例脚本**（`examples/`**）**、**一个 Stan 模型**（`inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan`**）**、**以及约 55 个 `man/*.Rd` 帮助文件**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**反向：谁接在我们已经收的东西上**」**——**⭐ 本轮的方法正是从**我们已经收录的工具**出发**，**去看**谁在它的 README 里用到它**（**本例是在**「**谁提到** `ChainLadder`**」**这一问下找到的**）**。

**可核实信息（均 `DESCRIPTION`、README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把整套方法的出发点压成一句话，而且那句话本身是一个**观点****——`DESCRIPTION` 逐字**：**「**Implements a unified framework for macro-level reserving in non-life insurance, based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**经典准备金方法并不是彼此无关的几套公式，**而是**同一个可信度估计框架在不同权重下的特例**」**——**⭐ 而它把这个观点落成了可运行的包**：**逐字**「**UCR nests Chain-Ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, and Cape Cod as special cases with data-adaptive credibility weights.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把「**矩不存在**」这件事做成了返回值**——**README 逐字**：**「**Tiered moment reporting**: `(1-W)/W` is Beta-prime, whose k-th moment is finite only when `c·F > k`. **The package enforces this and returns `NA` for the mean and standard error where they do not exist, rather than a number with no population counterpart.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**一个数**没有总体对应物**时，**正确的输出不是**一个看起来合理的数字**，**而是**缺失**——**⭐ 而「**enforces this**」**说明这不是文档建议，**而是**代码里的约束**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字指出自己的哪个函数**不该用****——**README 逐字给出**：**「**At the triangle sizes actually encountered the estimator is upward-biased by roughly a third at `I = 10`, and the closed-form asymptotic variance understates the true variance by a factor of two to sixteen; **use the bootstrap or the posterior, not `delta_method_var()`, for anything that matters**.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它给出**偏差的量级与发生条件**（**「**在 I = 10 时上行偏差约为三分之一**」**）**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它给出**闭式方差低估的倍数区间**（**「**两倍到十六倍**」**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「**可能不准**」，**而是**一个区间**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 它点名**具体函数**并给出替代**（**用 bootstrap 或后验**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 两个诊断不是一个门槛**——**README 逐字**：**「**Two diagnostics, not one threshold**: `diagnose_c()` reports the portfolio-specific operability bound `c†(τ) = τ/π₀` and, separately, the heterogeneity screen with its measured error rates. **They answer different questions and a portfolio can pass one while failing the other.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**这套方法在这个组合上能不能报数**」**与「**这个组合本身是否同质**」**是**两个独立问题**——**⭐ 本词条认为这比「**设一个阈值**」**更难也更有用**：**因为它要求作者**分别测出两个诊断的**实际错误率**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 它逐字给出「**插件法**」与「**积分法**」的**覆盖率差多少****——**逐字**：**「**The plug-in costs about 6 coverage points at `I = 10` under correct specification; integrating over `c` recovers about two of them and removes most of the conditional miscalibration across triangles.**」**。**⭐ 即**两种做法**都不完美**，**而**差多少被写明了**（**插件法在正确设定下仍损失约 6 个百分点覆盖率，**积分只补回约 2 个**）**——**⭐ 本词条如实标注**：「**约**」字是原文措辞**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 它连一处数学修正都写明了后果**——**逐字**：**「**a partial-column moment method with the subcomposition correction (the partial-column proportions carry concentration `c·F_k`, not `c`; **without the correction the estimator is inconsistent**)**」**。**⭐ 即**「**不做这个修正，估计量就不一致**」**——**不是「**更差**」，**而是**不一致**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 内容与方法可数**——`DESCRIPTION` **逐字列出它包含**：**负二项链梯（NB-CL）**、**统一可信度准备金（UCR）**、**Mack 的无分布模型**、**经典 Bühlmann-Straub 可信度理论**、**与模型无关的预测区间（Dirichlet-Multinomial 参数自举）**、**以及复合负二项–Gamma（CNBG）金额三角模型与其可识别性边界诊断**；**并逐字说明 CNBG 那一块**「**characterises what a paid-loss triangle can and cannot identify about reserve uncertainty**」，**以及它自带**「**the paper’s simulation calibration as its defaults**」**、**两种**working-likelihood **后验**（**论文的联合 (kappa, A) 网格 ＋ 一个 **Godambe 调整**的替代**）**、**一个精确的**frailty-augmented HMC **后验**（**对应仓库里的** `inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan`**）**、**一个 kappa 后验诊断**（**逐字含论文的** regime **与** KL-tier **分类，**并**flags when amount-only inference is unsupported**）**、**以及** Fisher／Godambe／van Trees **信息界**（**逐字**「**that reproduce the paper’s published table at the package defaults**」**）**。**⭐ 即**「**一个三角能告诉我们什么、**不能告诉我们什么**」**在这里是**可计算的诊断**，**而不是一句免责**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 安装方式与登记位置**——README 逐字给出 `devtools::install_github("robin-vo/hgr")`**，**而**本次**未在 CRAN 上看到该包**（**⭐ 即**它的登记处只有 GitHub 与帮助文件**）**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这与第 352 轮记下的 [[fitverse-r]]（**只在 CRAN、**只有只读镜像**）**恰好相反**——**两种「**只在一个登记处**」的形态**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[chainladder]] 与 [[chainladder-python]] 覆盖**链梯的实现**，**[[reservingmodels]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]]、[[deeptriangle]]、[[reserving-ml]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[oneyear-correlated-chainladder]] 覆盖**准备金方法与验证**，**[[clmplus]]、[[gi-loss-reserving]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-robust]] 覆盖**相邻取向**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**把经典方法统一成可信度估计量**」这一**理论框架**，**以及**「**矩不存在就返回 NA、**并指名不要用哪个函数**」这一**输出纪律**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[chainladder]]、[[reservingmodels]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「**同一批准备金方法其实是一个框架的特例**」这一视角**，**并附一套**逐条写明偏差与覆盖代价**的自述**；**⭐ 其中两点可以直接照抄**：**① 一个数**没有总体对应物**时返回缺失值；② 明确写出**哪个函数只适合做参考、**不适合做结论**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 R、没有安装该包、没有拟合任何模型**（**未 `install_github`、未跑任何示例、未跑其测试**），**故不主张** NB-CL／UCR／CNBG **按所述工作**，**也不主张**其任何覆盖率、偏差或信息界数字**成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 R 源码**（**只读了** `DESCRIPTION`、`README.md` **与文件清单；**四个 `.R` 文件与 55 个 `.Rd` **未打开**），**故不主张** UCR 的可信度权重如何估计、CNBG 的可识别性诊断如何实现、`NA` 返回在哪些函数里真的生效。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未读** `inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan` **与** `examples/` **下任何脚本**；**未核实**「**精确的** frailty-augmented HMC **后验**」**这一说法与其**采样设置**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实那些**数字**（**约三分之一的上行偏差、**两到十六倍的低估、**约 6 个覆盖率百分点、**「**复现论文已发表表格**」**）——**本次**未运行、**未对照论文**（**⭐ 原描述里的**「**the paper’s**」**指哪一篇，**本次**未核实**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实与 CRAN 的关系**：**本次**未在 CRAN 上检索该包名**，**故**只主张「**本次未见其在 CRAN**」**而不是「**它不在 CRAN**」。**⑥ ⚠️ 许可为 GPL (>= 3)（`DESCRIPTION` 字段）**，**⭐ 而**仓库内未见 `LICENSE` 文件****——**按惯例**以字段为准并如实指出缺文件**；**未读任何许可正文**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份**（**只读到姓名与一个**空的 ORCID 字段**）**；**★1 不构成质量证据**。**⑧ ⚠️ 创建 2026-01-29 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把经典准备金方法统一为可信度框架、**并自带可识别性诊断**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**（**池内覆盖各种实现与取向，但未有一条以**可信度理论**为主干**）。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。
e.body_hk:
**hgr**（**逐字全名**「**The hidden grammar of reserving**」）**是一個通用保險準備金方法的 R 套件**，**本次實測版本為** `0.5.0`**。**本次實測**：**GitHub 倉庫** `robin-vo/hgr`**，**建立 2026-01-29、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★1**、**R**；**許可**為 `GPL (>= 3)`（**`DESCRIPTION` 欄位**；**⭐ 本次清單裡未見 `LICENSE` 文件****）；**作者** `Robin Van Oirbeek`（**⭐ 其 `Authors@R` 的 ORCID 欄位為空字串，本詞條如實記錄**）**；**依賴**：`Imports` **逐字只有** `MASS`、`stats`、`graphics`，`Suggests` **逐字含** `ChainLadder`、`MCMCpack`、`rstan (>= 2.26.0)`、`testthat (>= 3.0.0)`、`ggplot2`**；**另有** `RoxygenNote: 7.2.3` **與** `Config/testthat/edition: 3`**。**文件清單實測 65 條**：`DESCRIPTION`、`NAMESPACE`、**四個 R 源檔**（`cnbg.R`、`multinomPI.R`、`nbcl.R`、`ucr.R`**）**、`README.md`（**8,165 位元組**）、**四個示例腳本**、**一個 Stan 模型**（`inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan`**）**、**約 55 個 `man/*.Rd`**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**反向：誰接在我們已經收的東西上**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 `DESCRIPTION`、README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 出發點是一句話，而那句話本身是一個**觀點****——**逐字**：**「**Implements a unified framework for macro-level reserving in non-life insurance, based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators.**」**，**並逐字**「**UCR nests Chain-Ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, and Cape Cod as special cases with data-adaptive credibility weights.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**矩不存在**」被做成了返回值**——**逐字**：**「**`(1-W)/W` is Beta-prime, whose k-th moment is finite only when `c·F > k`. The package enforces this and returns `NA` for the mean and standard error where they do not exist, **rather than a number with no population counterpart.**」**——**⭐ 即**一個數**沒有總體對應物**時，**正確輸出不是**一個看似合理的數字，**而是**缺失**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字指出自己哪個函式**不該用****——**逐字**：**「**the estimator is upward-biased by roughly a third at `I = 10`, and the closed-form asymptotic variance understates the true variance by a factor of two to sixteen; **use the bootstrap or the posterior, not `delta_method_var()`, for anything that matters**.**」**——**⭐ 即**不是「**可能不準**」，**而是**偏差量級、**低估倍數區間與**具體函式名**。**⭐⭐ ④ 兩個診斷不是一個門檻**——**逐字**：**「**Two diagnostics, not one threshold**: `diagnose_c()` reports the portfolio-specific operability bound `c†(τ) = τ/π₀` and, separately, the heterogeneity screen with its measured error rates. **They answer different questions and a portfolio can pass one while failing the other.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 它逐字給出兩種做法的**覆蓋率差多少****——**「**The plug-in costs about 6 coverage points at `I = 10` under correct specification; integrating over `c` recovers about two of them.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 連一處數學修正的後果都寫明**——**「**the partial-column proportions carry concentration `c·F_k`, not `c`; **without the correction the estimator is inconsistent**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 內容可數**：`DESCRIPTION` **逐字列出** NB-CL、UCR、Mack 無分布模型、Bühlmann-Straub 可信度理論、Dirichlet-Multinomial 參數自舉區間、**與** CNBG **金額三角模型及其可識別性邊界診斷**；**並逐字說明 CNBG**「**characterises what a paid-loss triangle can and cannot identify about reserve uncertainty**」**，**且自带**「**the paper’s simulation calibration as its defaults**」**、**兩種** working-likelihood **後驗**、**一個精確** HMC **後驗**、**一個 kappa 後驗診斷**（**flags when amount-only inference is unsupported****）**、**與** Fisher／Godambe／van Trees **資訊界**（**逐字**「**reproduce the paper’s published table at the package defaults**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 登記位置**：**安裝逐字為** `devtools::install_github("robin-vo/hgr")`**，**本次未在 CRAN 見到該套件**——**⭐ 與第 352 輪的 [[fitverse-r]]（**只在 CRAN、**只有唯讀鏡像**）**恰好相反**，**是另一種「**只在一個登記處**」**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[chainladder]]、[[reservingmodels]] 應當並讀**——**⭐ 其中兩點可直接照抄**：**① 一個數**沒有總體對應物**時回傳缺失值；② 明確寫出**哪個函式只適合做參考**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 R、沒有安裝該套件、沒有擬合任何模型**，**故不主張** NB-CL／UCR／CNBG **按所述工作**，**也不主張**任何覆蓋率、偏差或資訊界數字**成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 R 原始碼**（**只讀** `DESCRIPTION`、`README.md` **與文件清單**）。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未讀** `inst/stan/cnbg_exact.stan` **與** `examples/` **下任何腳本**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實那些數字**（**約三分之一上行偏差、**兩到十六倍低估、**約 6 個覆蓋率百分點、「**複現論文已發表表格**」**），**未對照論文**（**「**the paper’s**」指哪一篇本次未核實**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實與 CRAN 的關係**（**只主張「**本次未見**」**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 許可為 GPL (>= 3)（`DESCRIPTION` 欄位）**，**⭐ 而倉庫內未見 `LICENSE`**；**未讀任何許可正文**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份**；**★1 不構成品質證據**。**⑧ ⚠️ 建立 2026-01-29 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「把經典準備金方法統一為可信度框架、並自带可識別性診斷」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。
e.body_en:
The R package hgr, whose full title is the hidden grammar of reserving, **is a package of general insurance reserving methods**, measured this round at **version 0.5.0**. **Measured facts**: the GitHub repository was **created 2026-01-29** and **last pushed 2026-09-09**, with **one star** and R as the language; the licence field reads GPL version 3 or later **while no licence file is present in the repository**; the author field carries a name but an empty ORCID string, which this entry records as measured; and dependencies are unusually light, with only three imports and a suggested list containing the chain ladder package, a Markov chain package, Stan, testthat and ggplot2. **The file listing measures sixty-five entries**, holding a description file, a namespace, four R source files, a README of 8,165 bytes, four example scripts, a single Stan model and roughly fifty-five help files. **This entry belongs to the round theme of who builds on what we already carry, and this round method was to start from tools we have already collected and ask who uses them**, in this case asking who mentions the chain ladder package in a README.

**Verified information, all measured from the description file, the README and the file listing**: **first, the starting point is one sentence, and that sentence is a claim**: verbatim, the package implements a unified framework for macro-level reserving in non-life insurance, based on the insight that classical reserving methods are credibility estimators, and unified credibility reserving nests chain ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson and Cape Cod as special cases with data-adaptive credibility weights. **Classical reserving methods are not several unrelated formulas but special cases of one credibility estimator under different weights, and that view is shipped as runnable code.** **Second, a moment that does not exist became a return value**: verbatim, the ratio used is Beta-prime, whose k-th moment is finite only when the product of the concentration parameter and a factor exceeds k, and the package enforces this and returns a missing value for the mean and standard error where they do not exist rather than a number with no population counterpart. **When a number has no population counterpart, the correct output is absence rather than a plausible-looking figure, and the word enforces indicates that this is a constraint in the code rather than advice in the documentation.** **Third, it names verbatim which of its own functions should not be used**: the estimator is upward-biased by roughly a third at the triangle sizes actually encountered, the closed-form asymptotic variance understates the true variance by a factor of two to sixteen, and readers should use the bootstrap or the posterior rather than the closed-form variance function for anything that matters. **The bias is given as a magnitude with the condition under which it occurs, the understatement is given as a multiplier range rather than as a warning that results may be inaccurate, and a specific function is named along with its replacements.** **Fourth, two diagnostics rather than one threshold**: one reports the portfolio-specific operability bound and, separately, the heterogeneity screen with its measured error rates, and they answer different questions so that a portfolio can pass one while failing the other. **Whether the method can report on this portfolio at all and whether the portfolio is itself homogeneous are two independent questions, and this entry considers that harder and more useful than setting a single threshold, because it requires measuring the error rates of each diagnostic separately.** **Fifth, it states how much coverage the plug-in approach costs**: about six coverage points at the smaller triangle sizes under correct specification, of which integrating over the concentration recovers about two, and the integration also removes most of the conditional miscalibration across triangles. **Neither approach is perfect and the difference between them is quantified, with the word about being the original wording.** **Sixth, even a mathematical correction is given with its consequence**: a partial-column moment method with a subcomposition correction is used because the partial-column proportions carry a scaled concentration rather than the concentration itself, and without the correction the estimator is inconsistent, **which is a stronger statement than merely being worse**. **Seventh, the contents are enumerable**: the description lists negative binomial chain ladder, unified credibility reserving, a distribution-free model, classical credibility theory, model-agnostic prediction intervals via a parametric bootstrap, and a compound negative binomial gamma amount-triangle model with its identification-boundary diagnostics; it says of that last part verbatim that it characterises what a paid-loss triangle can and cannot identify about reserve uncertainty; and it ships the paper simulation calibration as its defaults, a working-likelihood posterior in two variants, an exact posterior, a diagnostic carrying the paper regime and tier classification that flags when amount-only inference is unsupported, and three information bounds that reproduce a published table at the package defaults. **What a triangle can and cannot tell you is therefore a computable diagnostic rather than a disclaimer.** **Eighth, where it is registered**: installation is given verbatim through a GitHub installer call, and **this round did not find the package on CRAN**, which is the exact opposite of the shape recorded last round for a package present only on CRAN behind a read-only mirror: two different forms of existing in only one registry. **Ninth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled chain ladder entries cover implementations, the pooled reserving method entries cover methods and verification, and the pooled packages with adjacent orientations cover other approaches, while this entry supplies both the theoretical frame that unifies the classical methods as credibility estimators and the output discipline of returning a missing value where a moment does not exist while naming the function that should not be trusted.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[chainladder]] and [[reservingmodels]]**, because **it offers the view that a family of reserving methods are special cases of one framework**, together with a self-description that quantifies its own bias and coverage cost, and because **two of its practices transfer directly: return absence when a number has no population counterpart, and write down which function is for reference only rather than for conclusions**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, R was not installed, the package was not installed and no model was fitted** — nothing was installed from GitHub, no example was run and no test was executed — **so negative binomial chain ladder, unified credibility reserving and the amount-triangle model are not claimed to work as described, and none of the coverage, bias or information-bound figures is claimed to hold**. **Second, no R source was read**: only the description file, the README and the file listing were read, and neither the four source files nor the fifty-five help files were opened, **so nothing is claimed about how the credibility weights are estimated, how the identification diagnostics are implemented, or in which functions the missing-value return actually takes effect; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the Stan model and the example scripts were not read**, so the claim of an exact posterior is relayed rather than verified. **Fourth, none of the quoted numbers was verified** — not the one-third bias, not the two-to-sixteen multiplier, not the six coverage points, and not the claim of reproducing a published table — no run was performed and **the paper referred to in the description was not identified or consulted**. **Fifth, the relationship to CRAN was not established**; this entry claims only that the package was not seen there this round, not that it is absent. **Sixth, the licence is GPL version 3 or later by the description field while no licence file is present**, which is recorded as measured, and no licence text was read. **Seventh, the author identity was not verified beyond a name and an empty ORCID field, and one star is not evidence of quality. Eighth, the creation date of 2026-01-29 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-09 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that unifying classical reserving methods as credibility estimators, together with a built-in identifiability diagnostic, had no counterpart in the pool**, which covers implementations and orientations but nothing built on credibility theory as its backbone. **Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
